items.label: Party registration
items.text: Listed as No Party Preference for 2026 in the Secretary of State party preference history; previously a Republican. He announced on March 6, 2026 that he had filed for re-election without party affiliation. (sources: California Secretary of State https://elections.cdn.sos.ca.gov/statewide-elections/2026-general/pph.pdf [search summary, primary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Kevin_Kiley [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: U.S. Representative for California's 3rd District under the pre-2026 map; member of the California State Assembly (6th District), first elected November 8, 2016 and twice re-elected. (sources: Produce Marketing Association (government profile) https://www.pma.com/siteassets/files/advocacy/government-profiles/rep.-kevin-kiley-r-ca-3.pdf [search summary, secondary]; CalMatters https://calmatters.org/politics/2026/03/kevin-kiley-chooses-reelection-district/ [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Career
items.text: Former California Deputy Attorney General; adjunct professor of law at the University of the Pacific, McGeorge School of Law. (sources: Produce Marketing Association (government profile) https://www.pma.com/siteassets/files/advocacy/government-profiles/rep.-kevin-kiley-r-ca-3.pdf [search summary, secondary]; Millennial Action Project / Future Caucus https://futurecaucus.org/?p=864 [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: B.A., Social Studies, Harvard University (2007); J.D., Yale Law School (2012); master's degree in secondary education, Loyola Marymount University. (sources: Produce Marketing Association (government profile) https://www.pma.com/siteassets/files/advocacy/government-profiles/rep.-kevin-kiley-r-ca-3.pdf [search summary, secondary])
